# Theme credits

Cadence's themes borrow fonts, techniques and code from these open-source projects. Thank you.

| Used in | Project | License | What we use |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ninety-Five | [98.css](https://github.com/jdan/98.css) by Jordan Scales | MIT (`98css/LICENSE`) | Pixelated MS Sans Serif webfonts, bevel box-shadow recipe |
| Chicago | [system.css](https://github.com/sakofchit/system.css) by Sakun Acharige | MIT (`systemcss/LICENSE`) | ChiKareGo2 and ChicagoFLF fonts (recreations by @blogmywiki), 1-bit window style |
| Cyberpunk | [Cyberpunk-2077-theme-css](https://github.com/gwannon/Cyberpunk-2077-theme-css) by gwannon | reference only | techniques re-implemented on Cadence markup (yellow world, cut-corner slabs, part-number tags, scanner line, angled heading rule); no code copied |
| Cyberpunk, Cybercore | [Rajdhani](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Rajdhani) by Indian Type Foundry | OFL 1.1 (`fonts/LICENSE-rajdhani.txt`) | the display font |
| Cybercore | [cybercore-css](https://github.com/sebyx07/cybercore-css) by sebyx07 | MIT (`fonts/LICENSE-cybercore-css.txt`) | palette (void / chrome / cyan / magenta / green), corner-bracket cards, neon-flow border, glitch heading and datastream ideas, re-implemented |
| Doodle Party | [css-doodle](https://github.com/css-doodle/css-doodle) by Yuan Chuan | MIT (`css-doodle/LICENSE`) | the web component, for the generative background |
| NES | [NES.css](https://github.com/nostalgic-css/NES.css) | MIT | component looks re-implemented on Cadence markup: pixel borders, titled containers, balloons, checkbox, progress, button colours, cursor |
| Discord | [discordian](https://github.com/radekkozak/discordian) by Radek Kozak (Obsidian theme) | MIT | Discord palette and channel-list layout ideas (re-implemented; no Discord assets or fonts) |
| Liquid Glass | (original) | — | Apple-style frosted glass, written for Cadence |
| MSN Messenger | homage, inspired by [manz's MSN Messenger 7.5 demo](https://codepen.io/manz/pen/XWgWyYz) and [onurdevs/msnclone](https://github.com/onurdevs/msnclone) | — | look and features re-created in CSS; no Microsoft logos, icons or sounds (tones are synthesized) |
| LimeWire | homage | — | 2000s P2P client look re-created in CSS; no LimeWire assets |
| NES, Terminal, CRT, Sketchbook | Press Start 2P, VT323, Comic Neue via [Fontsource](https://fontsource.org) | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/OFL-*.txt`) | webfonts |
| Sketchbook | [PaperCSS](https://github.com/papercss/papercss) | ISC | wobbly hand-drawn border-radius technique (re-implemented) |
| Tufte | [Tufte CSS](https://github.com/edwardtufte/tufte-css) by Dave Liepmann | MIT (`tufte/LICENSE`) | ET Book webfont (MIT, by Dmitry Krasny, Bonnie Scranton and Edward Tufte), typography rules |
| XP, Seven | [XP.css](https://github.com/botoxparty/XP.css) by Adam Hammad, [7.css](https://github.com/khang-nd/7.css) by Khang Nguyen | MIT | Luna / Aero look (gradients re-implemented, no Microsoft assets) |
| daisyUI set (30) | [daisyUI](https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui) by Pouya Saadeghi | MIT (`daisyui-LICENSE`) | theme colours and radii, converted from OKLCH by `scripts/build-daisy-themes.mjs` |
| Editor set | [Dracula](https://draculatheme.com), [One Dark](https://github.com/atom/atom), [Tokyo Night](https://github.com/enkia/tokyo-night-vscode-theme), [Catppuccin](https://catppuccin.com), [Gruvbox](https://github.com/morhetz/gruvbox), [Rosé Pine](https://rosepinetheme.com), [Night Owl](https://github.com/sdras/night-owl-vscode-theme), [GitHub Primer](https://primer.style), [Ayu](https://github.com/ayu-theme), [Everforest](https://github.com/sainnhe/everforest), [Kanagawa](https://github.com/rebelot/kanagawa.nvim), [SynthWave ’84](https://github.com/robb0wen/synthwave-vscode), Monokai | MIT (palettes) | published colour palettes only |
| Neo-Brutal, Neo-Brutal Sky | [NeoBrutalismCSS](https://github.com/matifandy8/NeoBrutalismCSS) by Matías Fandiño | MIT (`neobrutalism/LICENSE`) | palette, 3.5px borders / hard-shadow recipe (re-implemented); Lexend Mega + Public Sans via Fontsource (OFL, `fonts/OFL-*.txt`) |
| Claude, Reddit, Pocket Casts, Blades, Adventure, Platformer | homages (original) | — | palettes, layouts and textures re-created for Cadence; no logos, mascots, characters or brand artwork. Brick tile and coin are drawn here; the coin blip is synthesized |
| Claude, Reddit, Adventure | Source Serif 4, IBM Plex Sans, Cinzel via [Fontsource](https://fontsource.org) | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/OFL-SourceSerif4.txt`, `OFL-IBMPlexSans.txt`, `OFL-Cinzel.txt`) | webfonts |
| Movie & TV, Studio Ghibli (11) | homages (original) | — | palettes, textures, type and mood only; no characters, logos, title lettering, stills or quotes. Carpet, clouds, lanterns, leaves, crystals and paper are drawn here |
| Movie & TV, Studio Ghibli | Oswald, Courier Prime, Anton, Exo 2, Fredoka, Patrick Hand, IM Fell English, Cormorant Garamond, Nunito via [Fontsource](https://fontsource.org) | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/LICENSE-*.txt`) | webfonts |
| The Shining | Special Elite via Fontsource | Apache 2.0 (`fonts/LICENSE-special-elite.txt`) | webfont |
| Backrooms | user-supplied CodePens ("Backrooms UI", camcorder ScreenEffect) | reference | box bevel/screw/switch looks, palette, VHS static/tracking/OSD ideas, re-implemented; their photos not used |
| Backrooms | [Sometype Mono](https://github.com/googlefonts/sometype-mono) | OFL 1.1 (`fonts/LICENSE-sometype-mono.txt`) | the UI font |
| Bootstrap 6 | [Bootstrap](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap) 6.0.0-alpha.1 | MIT | colours, radius and focus ring read from its CSS by `scripts/build-framework-themes.mjs` |
| Bootswatch (26 palettes) | [Bootswatch](https://github.com/thomaspark/bootswatch) by Thomas Park | MIT | palettes read from each theme's CSS |
| Bulma | [Bulma](https://github.com/jgthms/bulma) by Jeremy Thomas | MIT | colours, radius, box shadow read from its CSS |
